title: AI Skills Get You 56% More Pay
description:
Do AI skills actually raise your salary? One analysis of nearly a billion job applications reportedly found a 56% wage premium for workers with AI skills over people in the exact same role without them. 

So how do you prove you have them? A university degree takes four years and six figures, or a certification costs a fraction of that and a few weeks of study. The catch: most AI certifications are garbage, nobody's checking them, nobody's impressed, and some are outright scams. 

Choosing the right way to prove your skills matters as much as having them.

#techwithtim #aiengineer #techjobs
